body.x: INTIN has displayed O’VIEW Air, a multi-therapy device which measures temperature-humidity and fine dust concentration, in CES 2019 ‘Design & Source & MIK NIGHT’, the largest technology show in the world held in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) to 11 (Fri).
Convenient diagnostic technology of INTIN provides a self-diagnostic medical device to solve daily health management problems.
The temperature-humidity and fine dust concentration measuring device, which had its debut through this show, is portable and manageable in use because of its compact size and intuitive interface.

O’VIEW M, a smart self-sperm testing device, can measure the number of active sperms under the standard of WHO, and it does not only have an algorithm of best sperm movement in the world but also Android and IOS service.
